name: theme-green
title: Green theme
description: Sets the brand colour to Green (#16a34a) for light and dark, with contrast checked.
author: Agentic UI <https://agentic-component.vercel.app>
docs:
Changes only the brand tokens (primary, primary-foreground, ring). Status colours and neutrals are not touched.
Note: this colour is close to the success status colour. Check that badges and errors still stand out.
